description.text:
Roar (啸) is one of the two booster packs of Shadow of the Blue Sea (碧海暗影), alongside Banish (逐). Shadow of the Blue Sea was the sixth Sword & Shield booster release in Simplified Chinese, on sale from 20 September 2024 in 5-card packs with one holo and 25-card packs with five. The Legendary Pokémon Lugia and Giratina lead it, each with a VSTAR Power.

Roar's headline card is Lugia VSTAR, whose VSTAR Power Ability, Star Assemble, puts up to two Colorless Pokémon from the discard pile onto the Bench, though not Pokémon with a special rule such as Pokémon V. Its partner is Archeops, a Stage 2 Pokémon that can come into play straight from the discard pile this way and whose Ability, Primal Turbo, attaches up to two Special Energy from the deck each turn. The Supporter Serena and the Item Capturing Aroma, also in Roar, help set the pair up.

Roar also has the Radiant Pokémon Tsareena, whose Ability heals 20 damage from each of its player's Pokémon once in each of their turns, and Jirachi, whose Ability takes up to three cards from the deck when it is Knocked Out in the Active Spot by damage from an opponent's attack; Hisuian Lilligant VSTAR, Magnezone VSTAR, Zacian VSTAR and Zamazenta VSTAR; and Miltank, whose Ability keeps it from taking damage from Pokémon V attacks, and Magmortar and Electivire, which work together, all three also as Art Rares. Its main cards are numbered out of 131; Art Rare, full-art, Special Art Rare, rainbow and gold cards are numbered past it, up to 169.
